live_verification_script.purpose: Manual end-to-end verification the coordinator could not execute (no chat-prompt-submission mechanism, same limitation as PRD 005 task 3a). Unit tests cover every code path; this script verifies the live experience.
steps: 1. Start dev (npm run dev in packages/electron), open an Agent Mode session.
2. Prompt the lead: 'Spawn a teammate named weatherman (model haiku) to fetch current Miami weather and report back via message when done.'

3. Watch the lead's transcript during the teammate's run: the lead must NOT run its own WebSearch/WebFetch/ToolSearch for the weather (bug 1). Continuation system messages, if any, should show the new wait/no-duplication wording.

4. When weatherman goes idle (even if it never calls SendMessage), the lead's conversation must receive a message containing weatherman's final answer within seconds (bug 2). The session must not sit deferred/stuck.
5. Open weatherman's thread popover: header shows a real tool-call count (>0) matching the transcript body, model shown, status idle.

6. Abort/stop the session (or switch away triggering provider abort). Re-open the popover / Teammates panel: weatherman shows Completed (not Error), tool-call count preserved; panel row shows 'general-purpose - haiku' style type+model (bug 3).
7. Optional resume check: before aborting, SendMessage weatherman a follow-up; after it replies and re-idles, its tool-call count must accumulate, not reset.
